clue.text: Healthy transport in decay

indicators.note: the word in tells us one piece sits inside the other here

parts.note: decay means rot
a bus is a means of transport

explanation.surface: A fit person travels around in something that is falling apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Healthy transport' reads as a phrase, but the definition stops at 'Healthy'; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Robust and healthy are synonyms describing strong, vigorous condition.

clue.text: Note given to the ill will get a rest

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
spite means malice or ill will

explanation.surface: A doctor's note for the sick person grants a break.
explanation.definitionFit: A respite is a short break or rest from something difficult.

clue.text: Plan to show an indecent picture

parts.note: blue means risqué or indecent
a print is a picture made by printing

explanation.surface: A scheme to display a rude image.
explanation.definitionFit: A blueprint is a detailed technical drawing or plan for building something.

clue.text: Put down for an indoor game

definitions.meaning: a racket sport played in a walled court

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to crush or suppress and a racket sport played on an enclosed court.

clue.text: Sail north, but ordered into port

indicators.note: ordered means put into a fresh arrangement, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sailor is told to head north, though instructed to put into harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' rearranges SAIL, N and BUT into the Turkish city. 'into' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Istanbul is a major Turkish seaport on the Bosphorus, an example of a port.

clue.text: Founder of a place of iniquity

definitions.meaning: to go down, as a ship fails and goes under
a ... of iniquity is a place full of vice

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to go under like a doomed ship and, in the phrase about iniquity, a den of vice.

clue.text: Confessed to having been taken in

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both owned up and allowed entry or received inside.

clue.text: You may play it but don't let little Josephine

parts.note: to ban is to not allow
Jo is a short form of Josephine

explanation.surface: Telling a parent not to let their young daughter play.
explanation.definitionFit: A banjo is a stringed instrument that people play.

clue.text: Stand for a lesson

parts.note: a church stand from which a scripture reading, called a lesson, is read

explanation.definitionFit: A lectern is a reading desk from which the Bible lesson is read in church.

clue.text: Imprison and reduce to silence

definitions.meaning: to lock someone away in confinement

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to confine somebody behind locked doors and to make somebody be quiet.

clue.text: It helps to remember income heartless men may make

indicators.note: may make suggests the letters can be reworked to form something new
heartless means the middle letter of the word men is removed

explanation.surface: A memory aid built from money and people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' takes E from MEN leaving MN; 'may make' shuffles INCOME plus MN.
explanation.definitionFit: A mnemonic is a memory aid, such as a rhyme for recalling facts.

clue.text: Firm agreement

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both dense and solid and a formal pact between parties.

clue.text: Tax or cheat

parts.note: an impost is a tax or duty

explanation.surface: A choice between paying duty and swindling.
explanation.definitionFit: An impostor is a fraud pretending to be someone else, a kind of cheat.

clue.text: Flashing light may bring movement to a stop

definitions.text: Flashing light may bring movement to a stop

parts.words: Flashing light may bring movement to a stop
parts.note: a rapidly pulsing lamp makes moving things appear frozen in place

explanation.definitionFit: This is a pulsing lamp used in discos that makes motion appear frozen.

clue.text: Neat and refined, but rather slow

indicators.note: refined means processed into a new form, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Something tidy and elegant, though a bit sluggish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refined' rearranges NEAT AND; 'but' is a link. Andante is a musical tempo marking.
explanation.definitionFit: Andante is a musical tempo marking meaning moderately slow.

clue.text: Issue of time off

indicators.note: off here signals the word time is turned round and read backwards

explanation.surface: A matter of taking a break from work.
explanation.definitionFit: To emit is to issue or send out, as a chimney discharges smoke.

clue.text: Free fall maybe enjoyed by sportsmen

definitions.text: Free fall maybe enjoyed by sportsmen

parts.note: free means open, as in unrestricted
fall, the American name for autumn, is an example of a season

explanation.surface: Skydivers enjoying a free fall.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: the hunting period is a free time, perhaps in autumn, that shooting sportsmen relish. Fall is American English for autumn.
explanation.definitionFit: Open season is the period when hunting a particular game is legally permitted.

clue.text: Smack one of the Seven Dwarfs for being careless

parts.note: to smack is to slap
Happy is one of Snow White's seven dwarfs

explanation.surface: Hitting a fairy-tale dwarf out of thoughtlessness.
explanation.definitionFit: Slaphappy means casual and irresponsible, a synonym for careless.

clue.text: Prank ceased being funny when father came in

indicators.note: came in means one piece goes inside the other
being funny suggests the letters behave oddly and are rearranged

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A joke stopped being amusing once Dad arrived.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signalled by 'being funny' gives ESCADE, which 'came in' opens up for the father; 'when' merely links.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapade is a daring or mischievous adventure, a prank.

clue.text: Lion is a cat violently opposed to mixing with mankind

indicators.note: violently suggests the letters are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: A big cat that fiercely shuns company.
explanation.definitionFit: Antisocial describes someone who avoids company and dislikes society.

clue.text: Select a quiet spot

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet
a point is a spot or place

explanation.surface: Choosing a peaceful place.
explanation.definitionFit: To appoint is to choose or name someone for a role.

clue.text: A head on one's shoulders

definitions.meaning: a headland, a point of land jutting into the sea
a sleeveless cloak worn over the shoulders

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a headland jutting into the sea and a short cloak worn around the shoulders.

clue.text: Shown to be vulnerable

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both revealed to view and left unprotected against attack.

clue.text: Sound sort of artist

indicators.note: sort of suggests a reordered version of the following word

explanation.surface: A healthy kind of painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges ARTIST. A sound is a narrow stretch of sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A strait and a sound are both narrow channels of water joining two seas.

clue.text: Timber producer well-liked but not socially acceptable

indicators.note: not means the following letter is left out of the word

parts.note: well-liked means popular
U is the British label for upper-class, socially acceptable usage

explanation.surface: A tree is liked by everyone yet frowned on by society.
explanation.walkthrough: U (from 'U and non-U', upper-class speech) is removed from POPULAR.
explanation.definitionFit: The poplar is a tall tree whose wood is used as timber.

clue.text: Finished with a dish from Italy

parts.note: past means over, finished

explanation.surface: Done with an Italian meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta is the classic Italian food of noodles such as spaghetti.

clue.text: Swindle to reduce the rent?

definitions.meaning: to sew closed a rip, a rent being a tear in fabric

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both a con or frame-up and the act of sewing closed a tear in cloth.

clue.text: One still is first to make a snowman

indicators.note: is first tells us the word for still comes ahead of the word for one

parts.note: still means yet
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A child stands still first to build a snowman.
explanation.walkthrough: The Abominable Snowman is another name for the yeti.
explanation.definitionFit: The yeti is the legendary Himalayan creature called the Abominable Snowman.

clue.text: Involved with gardening tools to a great extent

parts.note: involved with means in, as in being in on something
spades are digging tools used in gardening

explanation.surface: Someone busy in the garden with digging implements.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in great abundance or to a large degree.

clue.text: French writer quietly enters university grounds

indicators.note: enters means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Albert Camus was a French novelist
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly

explanation.surface: A French author slips silently into a university.
explanation.definitionFit: A campus is the land and buildings of a college or university.

clue.text: Unusually strained exchanges

indicators.note: unusually suggests the letters appear in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: Relations between people are oddly tense.
explanation.definitionFit: To trade in is to hand over an old item in part exchange for a new one.

clue.text: Stopped wearing corsets

definitions.meaning: stays are old-fashioned corsets, so this means fitted with them

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both remained in place and, from stays meaning corsets, wearing corsets.
